about: This is the SAMURAI SHODOWN base game.

After nearly ten years out of the spotlight, SAMURAI SHODOWN is back with a vengeance! Developed by the team behind the critically acclaimed KING OF FIGHTERS XIV, warriors and combatants from various backgrounds do battle on this legendary stage where a single strike can mean the difference between victory and defeat!
LEGACY: The same tense, high-damage single strike battles that the series is known for!
EVOLUTION: New, cinematic art style and updated fight mechanics bring each battle to life in a variety of online and offline modes.
REVOLUTION: Take on the top players in the world through a revolutionary AI system that learns player patterns and creates “Ghost” clones for you to take on in head-to-head battles.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
See Health Warnings for important health information before using this product.
